title: ContextRender: From Execution Dependencies to Agent Context
abstract: arXiv:2609.37743v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents performing long-horizon tasks accumulate tool results that later steps may need. Passing the full history to every invocation is costly even when it fits within the context window, while reducing it risks omitting needed information. Existing context management methods can overlook how earlier tool results are used in subsequent execution, leaving needed information out of context. We introduce ContextRender, which manages context through a persistent graph of execution dependencies. We develop Tool-Flow Analysis to track how later operations reuse information from earlier tool results, providing a signal called observed reuse. A renderer combines this signal with recency and semantic relevance to select results within a fixed history budget, retaining omitted results for later use. Across AppWorld and 8-objective QA with three execution models, ContextRender outperforms the evaluated context management baselines using a 6K hi

translated_title: ContextRender：从执行依赖到智能体上下文
translated_abstract: 执行长时程任务的LLM智能体会不断积累工具调用结果，后续步骤可能需要这些结果。即使完整历史能够放入上下文窗口，每次调用都传递全部历史也是代价高昂的，而缩减历史又可能遗漏所需信息。现有的上下文管理方法可能会忽视早期工具结果在后续执行中如何被使用，导致所需信息被排除在上下文之外。我们提出了ContextRender，它通过一个持久的执行依赖图来管理上下文。我们开发了工具流分析（Tool-Flow Analysis）来追踪后续操作如何复用早期工具结果中的信息，从而提供一种称为“观察到的复用”的信号。渲染器将这一信号与近因性和语义相关性相结合，在固定的历史预算内选择结果，并保留被省略的结果以备后用。在AppWorld和8目标QA任务上，使用三种执行模型进行评估，ContextRender在6K历史预算下优于所评估的各类上下文管理基线方法。
tldr: ContextRender通过持久执行依赖图和工具流分析追踪早期工具结果在后续执行中的复用情况，将该信号与近因性和语义相关性结合，在固定历史预算内智能选取上下文，性能超越现有上下文管理基线方法。
